T: Lunch is for wimps. Dinner is not.
D: A young stockbroker gets seduced by a ruthless corporate raider.
P: Serve dinner when Gekko gives the "greed is good" speech.
S: Hand-chopped raw beef with shallot, capers, cornichons and egg yolk
Finely chop chilled eye fillet by hand, mix with shallot, capers, cornichon, Dijon, Worcestershire and a yolk. Toasted brioche.
Fresh oysters on crushed ice, red wine vinegar and shallot dressing, lemon
Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon and a sharp red wine and shallot dressing.
Sushi rice seasoned with rice vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into salmon and tuna nigiri, plus cucumber maki, with wasabi and pickled ginger.
M: Butter-basted rib eye with a flamed brandy and cracked peppercorn cream sauce
Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard, basted with butter and rosemary, rested. Peppercorn sauce of brandy, stock and cream.
Bud's dad, honest work at the airline
Thick chuck patty seasoned at the last moment, griddled to medium, cheddar melted on top, lettuce, tomato and pickles on a toasted bun.
W: Baked cream cheese cheesecake with lemon zest on a biscuit crust
Biscuit base, cream cheese beaten with sugar, eggs and lemon, baked in a water bath at 150C for 60 minutes, sour cream topping baked 10 minutes more.
K: Bourbon, sugar syrup and bitters stirred over one big ice cube, citrus twist
Stir 60ml bourbon, 10ml sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice, strain over a big cube, orange twist.

flavour.sign: Gekko and Co. Lunch Is For Wimps

note.text: Lunch is for wimps. Eat at your desk, keep the phones lit, and never fall in love with a stock.

winks: Teldar Paper, the hostile takeover target
Carl Fox, Bud's dad, the Bluestar union man
Gekko's suspenders and the big phone
The greed speech at the shareholder meeting

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep well chilled

steps.text: Chop the chilled eye fillet very finely by hand with a sharp knife.
Mix with the diced shallot, capers, chopped cornichons, Dijon, Worcestershire and egg yolk. Season well.
Toast the brioche slices and serve alongside.
Shuck the oysters (or ask the fishmonger to) and lay them on crushed ice.
Mix the vinegar with the finely diced shallot and cracked pepper.
Cut the lemon into wedges and serve with the dressing on the side.

dishes.make_ahead: Dry-brine the steaks the night before

steps.text: The night before, salt the rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry-brine. Bring to room temperature 30 minutes before cooking.
Sear the steaks hard in a very hot oiled pan on both sides.
Add the butter and rosemary and baste the steaks. Rest on a plate for 8 minutes.
In the same pan, crush in the peppercorns, add the brandy and flame it carefully.
Add the stock and cream and reduce until the sauce coats a spoon.
Pour the sauce over the rested steaks.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the day before, chill overnight

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C. Mix the crushed biscuits with the melted butter and press into a lined springform tin.
Beat the cream cheese with the sugar, eggs and lemon zest until smooth, then pour over the base.
Bake in a water bath until just set with a slight wobble.
Spread the sour cream on top and bake a little longer.
Cool, then chill overnight before slicing. Chilling counts as part of the cooking time.
Stir the bourbon, sugar syrup and bitters over ice, in batches of one drink at a time, for about 30 seconds each.
Strain over one big ice cube in a short glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

edition.tagline: Lunch is for wimps. Dinner is not.
edition.cue: Serve dinner when Gekko gives the "greed is good" speech.

s.note: the power lunch Gekko doesn't bother eating
s.how: Finely chop 300g well-chilled eye fillet by hand. Mix with 1 diced shallot, 1 tbsp capers, 4 chopped cornichons, 1 tsp Dijon, a dash of Worcestershire and 1 yolk. Season well and serve with toasted brioche slices.
Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice. Mix 80ml red wine vinegar with 1 finely diced shallot and cracked pepper. Serve with lemon wedges and the dressing on the side.

m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Sear hard, then baste with 60g butter and rosemary and rest 8 minutes. In the pan, crush 1 tbsp peppercorns, flame 60ml brandy, add 125ml stock and 200ml cream and reduce until it coats a spoon.

w.note: the office birthday on the trading floor
w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs and lemon zest. Bake in a water bath at 150C for 60 minutes. Spread 300g sour cream on top and bake 10 minutes more. Chill overnight.

d.note: in Gekko's office, where greed is good
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 10ml sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds. Strain over one big ice cube in a short glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top. Makes four.
